shared_elements: band or column of repeated inscribed signs framing the scene
justification: Both are line-drawn commemorative slab designs whose figural content is bordered by rows or columns of repeated inscribed signs, and both include a human figure and vertical staff-like elements. But A depicts a small schematic horse with attendant figures above a field of interlaced ribbon-like serpentine knotwork, whereas B shows a single large, elaborately costumed standing figure in profile with headdress and ornaments; the forms, proportions and outline conventions have nothing specific in common.
